1.flavor: 在出生后的一段时间内，它会吸收背上种子里储存着的营养成长。
1.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
1.flavorEn: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.
1.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

2.flavor: 沐浴在阳光下越久，身体内会涌出越多力量，背上的花苞也会渐渐成长。
2.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
2.flavorEn: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.
2.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

3.flavor: 花朵散发出的迷人香味能安抚激动的心情，甚至消弭斗争。
3.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
3.flavorEn: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.
3.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

4.flavor: 生下来的时候，尾巴上就有火焰在燃烧。火焰熄灭时，它的生命也会结束。
4.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
4.flavorEn: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

5.flavor: 如果它在战斗中亢奋起来，就会喷出灼热的火焰，把周围的东西烧得一干二净。
5.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
5.flavorEn: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

6.flavor: 能用翅膀飞到距地面 1400米的高度。会吐出高温火焰。
6.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
6.flavorEn: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

7.flavor: 当它遇到危险的时候，会将四肢收回龟壳里保护自己，同时从嘴里喷出水来。
7.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
7.flavorEn: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.
7.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

8.flavor: 会灵巧地摆动自己毛茸茸的耳朵和尾巴，借此在水中保持平衡。
8.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
8.flavorEn: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.
8.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

9.flavor: 从龟壳上的大炮里放出的喷射水流足以贯穿厚实的铁板。
9.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
9.flavorEn: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.
9.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

10.flavor: 别看它的脚很短，因为是吸盘，所以无论是斜坡还是墙壁都能轻松前进。
10.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
10.flavorEn: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
10.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

11.flavor: 虽然有坚硬的外壳，因为壳里的身体很软，所以无法抵抗强力的攻击。
11.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
11.flavorEn: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.
11.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

12.flavor: 每天都忙着采集花蜜。习惯往腿部的细毛上涂满花蜜，然后带回巢穴里。
12.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
12.flavorEn: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
12.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

13.flavor: 头上长有尖锐的针。它喜欢藏在森林或草丛里大量吞食树叶。
13.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
13.flavorEn: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.
13.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

14.flavor: 虽然几乎动也动不了，但是如果遇到了危险，有时似乎会竖起毒刺来反抗。
14.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
14.flavorEn: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.
14.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

15.flavor: 它会用双手和尾部的3根毒针反复刺伤敌人。
15.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
15.flavorEn: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
15.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

16.flavor: 性格沉着冷静，即使受到攻击也很少反击，只会朝对手扬起沙子保护自己。
16.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
16.flavorEn: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

17.flavor: 拥有超群的体力，而且飞翔范围广，经常飞到很远的地方寻找食物。
17.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
17.flavorEn: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

18.flavor: 以2马赫的飞行速度来觅食。它巨大的爪子是非常令人惧怕的武器。
18.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
18.flavorEn: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

19.flavor: 有两颗大门牙，见什么咬什么。只要看到1只小拉达出没，附近肯定还住着40只以上。
19.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
19.flavorEn: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

20.flavor: 它的后脚上长着小蹼，以便它在水中游泳寻找食物。
20.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
20.flavorEn: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

21.flavor: 不擅长高空飞行。会以超高速在地盘里四处盘旋，以保护自己的地盘不被侵犯。
21.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
21.flavorEn: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

22.flavor: 很久以前就存在的宝可梦。哪怕只察觉到一丝危险，都会立即飞向高空。
22.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
22.flavorEn: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

23.flavor: 身体会随着年龄增长不断变长。每到夜里，它会一圈圈地将身体缠绕在树枝上休息。
23.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
23.flavorEn: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

24.flavor: 根据研究证实，它腹部那可怕的纹路大约有 6个种类已经得到确认。
24.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
24.flavorEn: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

25.flavor: 皮卡丘们把尾巴贴在一起交换电流，其实是在互相打招呼。
25.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
25.flavorEn: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
25.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

26.flavor: 如果电囊空了，它就会直直地竖起尾巴，收集空气中的电流。
26.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
26.flavorEn: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.
26.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

27.flavor: 会在地上挖洞建造巢穴。挖洞时，即便遇到地里的坚硬岩石，也能用尖锐的爪子弄碎后继续挖进。
27.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
27.flavorEn: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.
27.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

28.flavor: 会将锐利的爪子钩在树上爬树。这是为了设法使树果掉落，分给等在树下的穿山鼠们。
28.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
28.flavorEn: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.
28.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

29.flavor: 用坚硬的门牙咬碎树果吃。和雄性相比，角的尖端稍圆一些。
29.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
29.flavorEn: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.

30.flavor: 如果族群遇到了危险，会和伙伴们团结起来，施展出超音波大合唱。
30.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
30.flavorEn: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

31.flavor: 把孩子放在背上刺与刺的空隙里来哄它们。在这时绝对不会释放毒素。
31.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
31.flavorEn: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

32.flavor: 身材虽小，却性格勇敢。为了保护相好的雌性，会不顾生命果敢地战斗。
32.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
32.flavorEn: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it's friendly with.

33.flavor: 神经敏感，动不动就打架。体内的肾上腺素一增加，毒素的浓度也会提高。
33.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
33.flavorEn: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

34.flavor: 以力量为傲的宝可梦。用自己的粗尾巴和连钻石都能击碎的角，豪爽地战斗。
34.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
34.flavorEn: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

35.flavor: 因可爱的举止和叫声而广受欢迎的宝可梦。不过很少被人发现。
35.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
35.flavorEn: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

36.flavor: 听觉灵敏，连1公里以外针落地的声音都听得见，因此平时会待在安静的地方。
36.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
36.flavorEn: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

37.flavor: 随着身体的成长， 6根尾巴的毛发也会变得更漂亮。紧紧抱着它时能感到微微的温暖。
37.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
37.flavorEn: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

38.flavor: 聪明伶俐，但爱记仇。据说如果敢乱抓它的尾巴，它就会缠着你作祟1000年。
38.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
38.flavorEn: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

39.flavor: 能够随意改变声音的波长，唱出听了绝对会犯困的神奇旋律。
39.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
39.flavorEn: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

40.flavor: 以自己细腻的体毛为傲。尤其是额头上的卷毛，更是有着天堂般的极致触感。
40.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
40.flavorEn: It's proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that's perfectly heavenly.

41.flavor: 栖息在晒不到阳光的洞窟里。到了早晨便会和同伴聚集起来，一边互相取暖一边睡觉。
41.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
41.flavorEn: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.

42.flavor: 用小而灵活的脚走路。会悄悄接近正在睡觉的猎物，用尖牙咬住对方吸取血液。
42.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
42.flavorEn: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.

43.flavor: 白天会为躲避太阳而钻入凉爽的地下。会通过沐浴月光成长。
43.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
43.flavorEn: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
43.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

44.flavor: 看似口水的东西其实是甜甜的蜜。非常黏稠，只要碰到就会一直黏住。
44.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
44.flavorEn: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
44.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

45.flavor: 虽然花瓣越大，就能放出越多的花粉，但这样脑袋会变沉，容易疲倦。
45.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
45.flavorEn: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
45.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

46.flavor: 它会通过挖洞来从树根里吸取营养，但大部分营养都会被背上的蘑菇抢走。
46.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
46.flavorEn: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.
46.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

47.flavor: 由于虫子的精华不断被吸走，在思考的似乎已经不是虫子，而是背上的蘑菇了。
47.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
47.flavorEn: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.
47.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

48.flavor: 在明亮的地方你便能发现它具有雷达功能的大眼其实是由许多个小眼睛聚集而成的。
48.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
48.flavorEn: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.
48.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

49.flavor: 如果不小心把它翅膀上的鳞粉沾到了身上，那不但会很难去除，更糟的是毒素也会从那里渗入。
49.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
49.flavorEn: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.
49.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

50.flavor: 在地下较浅的地方移动。被它挖掘过的地面会鼓起来，所以非常容易发现。
50.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
50.flavorEn: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
50.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

51.flavor: 三胞胎的地鼠，拥有能够挖掘到地下100公里深的潜力。没人知道它在地下的部分究竟长成什么样子。
51.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
51.flavorEn: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.
51.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

52.flavor: 为了不弄脏额头上的金币，会常常洗脸。和伽勒尔的喵喵关系不好。
52.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
52.flavorEn: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.

53.flavor: 拥有优雅高贵的身姿。与野蛮的喵头目性格不合，互相看不起对方。
53.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
53.flavorEn: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

54.flavor: 头痛会随着压力逐渐累积而不断加剧。会用强大的念力击垮周围的一切。
54.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
54.flavorEn: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.
54.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

55.flavor: 古老的故事中说，它会把污染河水的人类拖进水中带走。
55.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
55.flavorEn: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.
55.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

56.flavor: 身体轻盈，在树上生活。常因鸡毛蒜皮的小事发火而飞扑到周围的东西上。
56.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
56.flavorEn: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

57.flavor: 只有在谁都不在身边的时候才不生气，但几乎没有人目击过这种情况。
57.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
57.flavorEn: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

58.flavor: 性格忠诚。为了保护自己的训练家，会拼命地朝对手狂吠。
58.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
58.flavorEn: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

59.flavor: 从古时候起就是俘获了众多人心的美丽宝可梦。能像飞一样轻巧地奔跑。
59.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
59.flavorEn: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

60.flavor: 在水流湍急的河里，会把厚厚的嘴唇像吸盘那样紧紧吸在岩石上避免被冲走。
60.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
60.flavorEn: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.
60.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

61.flavor: 流出的汗是黏滑的粘液状。即使被敌人捉住，也能哧溜一下滑走逃脱。
61.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
61.flavorEn: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.
61.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

62.flavor: 除了游泳还擅长格斗技。能用经过锻炼的手臂使出豪迈强力的拳击。
62.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
62.flavorEn: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.
62.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

63.flavor: 能够在睡梦中使出瞬间移动。据说它睡得越熟，就能移动到越遥远的地方。
63.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
63.flavorEn: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

64.flavor: 念力的威力大得惊人。会把精神力量储存在额头的星星里，以备进化之需。
64.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
64.flavorEn: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

65.flavor: 会操纵强大的超能力。据说它双手握着的汤勺就是用那力量制造出来的。
65.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
65.flavorEn: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

66.flavor: 时时刻刻都充满力量。由于体力过剩而去举起岩石消磨时间，也因此变得更强。
66.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
66.flavorEn: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

67.flavor: 有着不会疲劳的强韧肉体。会去帮助人类完成例如搬运沉重行李之类的工作。
67.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
67.flavorEn: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

68.flavor: 4只手臂在思考之前就会反射性地行动，使出多发拳击。
68.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
68.flavorEn: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

69.flavor: 喜欢温度高，有一定湿度的地方。它会用身上的藤蔓抓小虫来吃。
69.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
69.flavorEn: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.
69.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

70.flavor: 它在肚子饿的时候会吞掉周围会动的东西，分泌溶解液让其致命。
70.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
70.flavorEn: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.
70.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

71.flavor: 用花蜜的香味引诱猎物。据说被它吞入嘴里的东西，只要1天就会溶解到连骨头都不剩。
71.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
71.flavorEn: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.
71.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

72.flavor: 身体的大部分由水组成。在海中，会和海水混为一体，非常难以发现。
72.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
72.flavorEn: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.
72.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

73.flavor: 80根触手伸缩自如。会像撒网那样伸开触手抓住猎物并刺入毒针。
73.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
73.flavorEn: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.
73.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

74.flavor: 大多栖息于山路。由于不留神踩到它会使它大发雷霆，得多加小心。
74.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
74.flavorEn: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.
74.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

75.flavor: 常在山路上滚来滚去。滚动时从来不关心前面的路上都有什么。
75.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
75.flavorEn: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.
75.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

76.flavor: 刚蜕皮时浑身都白白的非常柔软，但是接触到空气之后会迅速变坚硬。
76.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
76.flavorEn: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.
76.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

77.flavor: 得到了小火马认可的人，在触摸它燃烧着的鬃毛时不会觉得烫手，真是不可思议。
77.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
77.flavorEn: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

78.flavor: 奔跑速度最快的烈焰马会成为首领，决定族群前往的地点和奔跑速度。
78.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
78.flavorEn: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

79.flavor: 把尾巴泡在水里后会有甜味渗出，因此它会以尾巴为诱饵吸引宝可梦并将其钓起。
79.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
79.flavorEn: When this Pokémon's tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.
79.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

80.flavor: 因为被大舌贝咬住而受到的刺激使它变得能够两足直立行走。当大舌贝离开后，它似乎就会变回呆呆兽。
80.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
80.flavorEn: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.
80.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

81.flavor: 靠吃电来维持生命。会一边从左右两边的组件放射电磁波一边在空中飞行。
81.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
81.flavorEn: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.
81.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

82.flavor: 会不断释放很强的的磁力。在三合一磁怪接近时，大多数电脑都会发生异常情况。
82.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
82.flavorEn: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.
82.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

83.flavor: 用植物的茎来战斗。茎的挥舞方式存在着好几种不同的流派。
83.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
83.flavorEn: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

84.flavor: 羽毛较短所以不擅长飞行，但是拥有发达的双脚，能够以很快的速度奔跑。
84.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
84.flavorEn: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

85.flavor: 由嘟嘟的某个头分裂出的变种。以60千米的时速在草原上奔跑。
85.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
85.flavorEn: One of Doduo's two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

86.flavor: 喜欢天寒地冻的地方，就算零下10度也能愉快地游泳。
86.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
86.flavorEn: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.
86.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

87.flavor: 全身像雪一样白。十分耐寒，即使是在有浮冰的大海里也能很精神地游来游去。
87.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
87.flavorEn: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.
87.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

88.flavor: 它由囤积的淤泥而形成。臭到让人无法碰触，凡是它走过的地方都寸草不生。
88.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
88.flavorEn: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.

89.flavor: 非常难闻！气味臭到让人窒息，但由于鼻子的退化，它自己完全闻不到味道。
89.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
89.flavorEn: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

90.flavor: 坚硬的壳能反弹任何攻击。壳打开时，如果里面的部分受到攻击，就会变得很脆弱。
90.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
90.flavorEn: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
90.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

91.flavor: 一旦它把壳闭上，无论是拥有什么样怪力的人都无法将其打开。
91.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
91.flavorEn: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.
91.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

92.flavor: 能用稀薄气体状的身体潜入任何地方，但只要起风就会被吹跑。
92.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
92.flavorEn: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

93.flavor: 如果黑暗中空空如也，但你却感觉被什么盯上了，那么鬼斯通一定就在那里。
93.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
93.flavorEn: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

94.flavor: 据说它会为了夺取山中遇难者的生命而从黑暗中出现。
94.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
94.flavorEn: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

95.flavor: 弯曲扭动巨大结实的身体，以时速80公里的猛烈劲头向前挖进。
95.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
95.flavorEn: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.
95.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

96.flavor: 如果你每晚与它一起睡觉，它偶尔会让你梦见它以前吃过的梦。
96.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
96.flavorEn: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

97.flavor: 无意中遇到它的时候，如果不小心和它对上视线会很危险。它手里拿着的钟摆会让人睡着。
97.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
97.flavorEn: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

98.flavor: 如果危险逼近，就会从嘴里吐出泡沫包裹全身，让身体看起来更大。
98.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
98.flavorEn: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
98.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

99.flavor: 巨大的钳子破坏力十足，但是因为太过沉重，不战斗的时候就很碍事。
99.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
99.flavorEn: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
99.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

100.flavor: 据说它与精灵球相似的外形其实是它的保护色，但它很容易自爆这一点也出人意料。
100.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
100.flavorEn: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
100.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

101.flavor: 只要受到一点撞击，就会由于体内的电能溢出导致爆炸。
101.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
101.flavorEn: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
101.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

102.flavor: 6只不在一起就不安心。哪怕只是少了1只，都会马上想要逃跑。
102.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
102.flavorEn: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.
102.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

103.flavor: 3个脑袋联合起来能使出强大的精神力量。天气变阴时动作会变得迟钝。
103.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
103.flavorEn: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.
103.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

104.flavor: 它头上戴着死去母亲的头骨。虽然也会因悲伤的梦境而哭泣，但每流一次泪，都会变得更加坚强。
104.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
104.flavorEn: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.
104.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

105.flavor: 进化后，与原本戴在头上的母亲头骨完全融为一体，而且性格也变得十分凶暴。
105.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
105.flavorEn: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.
105.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

106.flavor: 腿能自由地伸缩，即使离得很远，也能把对手踢飞。
106.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
106.flavorEn: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

107.flavor: 打出的拳击甚至能劈开空气。但攻击3分钟后，它似乎就会想休息一下。
107.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
107.flavorEn: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

108.flavor: 主要以虫宝可梦为食。会用长长的舌头舔对手，等对手麻痹后将其整个吞下。
108.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
108.flavorEn: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

109.flavor: 污浊的空气是它的美味大餐。据说在昔日的伽勒尔地区曾经存在着更多的瓦斯弹。
109.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
109.flavorEn: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

110.flavor: 虽然吸入空气的力量稍弱于伽勒尔的双弹瓦斯，制造出的毒素却更加强力。
110.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
110.flavorEn: It can't suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

111.flavor: 脑子里只能记住一件事。一旦开始猛冲，不管理由是什么都会很快感到无所谓而忘掉。
111.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
111.flavorEn: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.
111.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

112.flavor: 全身被铠甲般的皮肤保护着。甚至能在2000度的熔岩里生存。
112.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
112.flavorEn: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.
112.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

113.flavor: 原本动作迟缓。为了保护蛋不被抢走，逃跑的速度才变快了。
113.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
113.flavorEn: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

114.flavor: 藤蔓有着独特的香气。在伽勒尔的部分地区被当做香草使用。
114.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
114.flavorEn: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.
114.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

115.flavor: 据记载，曾有没孩子的袋兽将遇难人类的小孩抚养长大。
115.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
115.flavorEn: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

116.flavor: 会像跳舞一样在水中游动以制造漩涡。作为娱乐，会和伙伴比拼谁的漩涡更大。
116.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
116.flavorEn: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.
116.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

117.flavor: 嘴巴虽然细，吸引力却很强。就算是比嘴巴还大的猎物，也能一瞬间吸进嘴里吃掉。
117.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
117.flavorEn: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.
117.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

118.flavor: 背鳍和尾鳍像肌肉那样发达。能够以 5节的速度在水中游泳。
118.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
118.flavorEn: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.
118.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

119.flavor: 金鱼王之所以会用角挖穿河底的岩石来筑巢，是为了防止产下的卵被水流冲走。
119.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
119.flavorEn: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.
119.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

120.flavor: 虽然会遭到鱼宝可梦的啄食，但身体即使被咬掉一块也能马上再生，所以完全不在意。
120.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
120.flavorEn: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.
120.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

121.flavor: 会高速旋转着身体一边游泳一边吸收微小的浮游生物。
121.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
121.flavorEn: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.
121.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

122.flavor: 擅长表演默剧。用手指放出的波动制造墙壁，保护自己免于大多数攻击。
122.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
122.flavorEn: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

123.flavor: 如果在森林中发现某个地方有大量树木被砍倒，就说明那里是飞天螳螂的领地。
123.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
123.flavorEn: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.
123.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

124.flavor: 伽勒尔的迷唇姐外表靓丽，拥有纤细叫声的也不在少数，甚至有为其着迷的粉丝。
124.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
124.flavorEn: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.
124.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

125.flavor: 暴风雨来临时，它们就会集结在高高的大树周围，耐心地等待落雷。
125.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
125.flavorEn: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.
125.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

126.flavor: 全身时刻都在燃烧。大家认为它是引发火灾的原因之一，非常惧怕它。
126.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
126.flavorEn: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

127.flavor: 用角夹住猎物后，不是直接把对方切成两半，就是强行把对方扔飞。
127.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
127.flavorEn: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.
127.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

128.flavor: 栖息在伽勒尔的肯泰罗性格暴躁，决不允许人类骑在自己的背上。
128.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
128.flavorEn: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won't allow people to ride on their backs.

129.flavor: 又弱又可怜的宝可梦。在水流比较快的地方只能任凭自己被水冲走。
129.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
129.flavorEn: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.
129.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

130.flavor: 就算是在狂风暴雨中，只要发狂的暴鲤龙出现，一切都会被它烧毁殆尽。
130.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
130.flavorEn: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.
130.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

131.flavor: 十分耐寒，不畏冰海。皮肤滑滑的，摸上去会有点凉。
131.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
131.flavorEn: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.
131.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

132.flavor: 当两只百变怪相遇的时候，为了能变成和对方相同的样子，它们动起来会比平常更加剧烈。
132.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
132.flavorEn: When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

133.flavor: 由于不稳定的遗传基因，蕴含着各种各样进化可能性的特殊宝可梦。
133.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
133.flavorEn: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

134.flavor: 身体细胞的结构与水分子相似。它能和水融为一体，让别人无法看见它。
134.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
134.flavorEn: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.
134.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

135.flavor: 能够吸入空气中的负离子，有时会吐出大约有 10000伏特的高压电。
135.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
135.flavorEn: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.
135.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

136.flavor: 会将吸入的空气的一部分传送到自己体内的火囊里，制造出1700度的火焰。
136.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
136.flavorEn: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

137.flavor: 近年来十分活跃于电脑空间。到处检查有没有可疑的数据。
137.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
137.flavorEn: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

138.flavor: 已经灭绝的古代宝可梦。依靠10只脚来划水，在水中轻盈地游曳。
138.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
138.flavorEn: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.
138.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

139.flavor: 拥有足以咬碎岩石的锋利牙齿，但是能够袭击的猎物仅限触手可以伸展的范围之内。
139.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
139.flavorEn: Omastar's sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.
139.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

140.flavor: 虽然存在已经灭绝的说法，但据说在一部分地区还是经常能见到它的身影。
140.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
140.flavorEn: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.
140.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

141.flavor: 灭绝的原因尚不明确。曾经栖息在温暖的大海，是性格残暴的古代宝可梦。
141.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
141.flavorEn: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.
141.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

142.flavor: 长着锯子般的牙齿。甚至连钢属性宝可梦的皮肤都会被它的牙齿撕成碎片。
142.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
142.flavorEn: Aerodactyl's sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.
142.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

143.flavor: 拥有一个结实的胃，即使吃了发霉腐烂的东西，也完全不会吃坏肚子。
143.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
143.flavorEn: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

144.flavor: 拥有能够自由操纵冰的能力。据说它栖息在永久冻土的雪山。
144.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
144.flavorEn: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.
144.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

145.flavor: 传说的鸟宝可梦。据说只要它一摩擦翅膀，就会立刻发生落雷。
145.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
145.flavorEn: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It's said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.
145.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

146.flavor: 相传它会用燃烧着的美丽翅膀照亮山道，救助在此遇险的人。
146.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
146.flavorEn: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

147.flavor: 长久以来被认为只存在于幻想之中。额头小小的突起是正在发育的角。
147.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
147.flavorEn: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini's forehead is actually a horn that's still coming in.
147.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

148.flavor: 把力量集中在尾巴的珠子上操纵天气。散发气场的样子非常神秘。
148.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
148.flavorEn: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.
148.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

149.flavor: 被称为大海的化身。很多船都会把快龙的雕像设置在船头。
149.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
149.flavorEn: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.
149.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

150.flavor: 超梦的基因几乎和梦幻完全一样，但是大小和性格却迥异得让人吃惊。
150.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
150.flavorEn: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew's. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

151.flavor: 用显微镜可以看到它身上极短极细且密集的体毛。
151.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
151.flavorEn: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon's short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.

152.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
152.flavorEn: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.
152.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

153.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
153.flavorEn: Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
153.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

154.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
154.flavorEn: The fragrance of Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.
154.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

155.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
155.flavorEn: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

156.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
156.flavorEn: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

157.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
157.flavorEn: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

158.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
158.flavorEn: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.
158.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

159.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
159.flavorEn: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
159.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

160.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
160.flavorEn: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
160.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

161.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
161.flavorEn: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

162.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
162.flavorEn: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

163.flavor: 总是在固定的时间鸣叫，因此也有训练家拿它来代替钟表带出门。
163.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
163.flavorEn: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

164.flavor: 开始思考事情时，会将脖子旋转180度，以此提高大脑的工作效率。
164.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
164.flavorEn: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

165.flavor: 非常胆小的宝可梦。会和伙伴一起张开反射壁来保护巢穴。
165.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
165.flavorEn: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.
165.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

166.flavor: 在夜空中飞翔的同时会抛撒闪闪发光的粉末。据说粉末沾到身上就会有好事发生。
166.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
166.flavorEn: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.
166.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

167.flavor: 牙齿上的毒并不强烈，但用来削弱那些挂在网上无法动弹的猎物是绰绰有余了。
167.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
167.flavorEn: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.
167.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

168.flavor: 会通过吐丝来捕捉猎物。到了晚上，就会离开巢穴并积极地狩猎。
168.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
168.flavorEn: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.
168.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

169.flavor: 可以自由地控制4根翅膀振翅而飞。即使在狭窄的洞窟内也能保持速度飞来飞去。
169.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
169.flavorEn: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

170.flavor: 在黑暗的海底，触手上不断闪烁着的光是它们唯一的通信手段。
170.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
170.flavorEn: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
170.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

171.flavor: 发出强光蒙住猎物的眼睛。抓住那一瞬间的空档，使其遭受电的攻击。
171.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
171.flavorEn: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.
171.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

172.flavor: 脸颊上的电囊还很小，如果囊里的电太多了，就会漏出来电到自己。
172.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
172.flavorEn: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.
172.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

173.flavor: 有着星星一样的轮廓。由于那外形，人们相信它是乘着流星而来的。
173.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
173.flavorEn: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

174.flavor: 用柔软的身体弹跳著移动。当它的体温上升时，身体会变成深粉红色。
174.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
174.flavorEn: Taking advantage of the softness of its body, Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a deep pink when its temperature rises.

175.flavor: 好运的象征。据说在它的壳里装着满满的幸福。
175.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
175.flavorEn: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

176.flavor: 不待在温柔的人身边就会变得没有精神。不挥动翅膀也能浮在空中。
176.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
176.flavorEn: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.

177.flavor: 由于羽翼未丰，所以会跳着移动。一直在注视着什么。
177.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
177.flavorEn: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

178.flavor: 能够看穿过去和未来。日复一日注视着太阳动向的奇异宝可梦。
178.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
178.flavorEn: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

179.flavor: 绒毛摩擦产生的电力会被储存起来。如果觉得可爱而直接用手碰它的话，就会被啪地一下电得又麻又痛。
179.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
179.flavorEn: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.
179.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

180.flavor: 能将电力储存在松软的毛发中。因为储存了太多电力，所以身上有些地方已经变得光秃秃的了。
180.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
180.flavorEn: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.
180.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

181.flavor: 尾巴会发出很强的亮光。从以前起，它就被船员们当做路标而深受重视。
181.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
181.flavorEn: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.
181.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

182.flavor: 有时能看到美丽花聚在一起做着像是跳舞一样的动作。据说这是呼唤太阳的仪式。
182.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
182.flavorEn: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
182.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

183.flavor: 体毛的防水性能很好，就算是从冰冷的海里上岸，身体也会立刻干掉，一点都不冷。
183.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
183.flavorEn: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That's why this Pokémon is never cold.
183.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

184.flavor: 会制作填满空气的泡泡。当露力丽在河里玩的时候，它就会用这个泡泡包住露力丽。
184.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
184.flavorEn: These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.
184.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

185.flavor: 为了不被袭击会模仿树的样子。很讨厌水，所以下雨后，不知什么时候就会消失。
185.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
185.flavorEn: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.
185.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

186.flavor: 雄性的叫声更响亮。叫声低沉可怕的蚊香蛙皇更能受到雌性的欢迎。
186.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
186.flavorEn: The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.
186.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

187.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
187.flavorEn: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.
187.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

188.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
188.flavorEn: Skiploom's flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.
188.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

189.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
189.flavorEn: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
189.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

330.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
330.flavorEn: It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.
330.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

331.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
331.flavorEn: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.
331.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

332.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
332.flavorEn: If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.
332.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

333.flavor: 看起来像是一团棉花云，因此不易被敌人发现。据说翅膀是随着世代演进逐渐变白的。
333.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
333.flavorEn: Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.

334.flavor: 虽然性情温顺，但如果被惹怒，就会用尖锐的叫声威吓对方，并且毫不留情地发动进攻。
334.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
334.flavorEn: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it's provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.
334.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

335.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
335.flavorEn: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.

336.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
336.flavorEn: Seviper's swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.

337.flavor: 第一次发现它是在 40年前陨石坠落的地方。只要注视敌人就能使其入睡。
337.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
337.flavorEn: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.
337.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

338.flavor: 太阳能量是其力量之源，所以白天会很强。旋转时身体会发光。
338.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
338.flavorEn: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
338.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

339.flavor: 会用2根长长的胡须探索浑浊的河底。用湿滑的粘膜保护着身体。
339.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
339.flavorEn: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.
339.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

340.flavor: 会将大沼泽划为自己的领地。如果有敌人接近的话，它就会狂暴起来，并引发大地震。
340.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
340.flavorEn: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.
340.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

341.flavor: 来自于外国的宝可梦，现在已经回归了野生环境。不管多么污浊的河水都能适应。
341.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
341.flavorEn: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.
341.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

342.flavor: 有着热爱战斗的性格。当遇到靠近自己领地的对手，会毫不留情地将之打倒。
342.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
342.flavorEn: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.
342.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

343.flavor: 在古代遗迹被发现。会一边旋转一边移动。晚上睡觉的时候也是单脚站着。
343.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
343.flavorEn: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.
343.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

344.flavor: 似乎是从古代人做的泥偶诞生而来的宝可梦。能靠念力浮在空中移动。
344.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
344.flavorEn: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.
344.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

345.flavor: 会吸附在海底岩石上，用花瓣一样的触手缠住接近自己的猎物。
345.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
345.flavorEn: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.
345.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

346.flavor: 用触手将猎物缠住后，会用消化液将其溶化，然后吸收其中的养分。
346.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
346.flavorEn: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.
346.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

347.flavor: 会把8根翅膀当做船桨划水，并且游泳的速度相当快。是虫宝可梦的一种祖先。
347.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
347.flavorEn: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.
347.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

348.flavor: 栖息在陆地，但也擅长游泳。会潜入大海寻找猎物，用锋利的爪子给予致命一击。
348.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
348.flavorEn: Though it lives on land, it's also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.
348.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

349.flavor: 虽然外表丑陋，但拥有顽强的生命力，只要少量的水就能存活。
349.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
349.flavorEn: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
349.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

350.flavor: 据说目睹了美纳斯美丽身姿的人，心中一切的愤恨都能得到抚慰。
350.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
350.flavorEn: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.
350.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

351.flavor: 样子会根据天气发生变化。天气越恶劣，性格也会变得越暴躁。
351.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
351.flavorEn: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

352.flavor: 在不隐身的时候，身体的颜色也会随着心情和状态改变。颜色越浓的时候越有精神。
352.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
352.flavorEn: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

353.flavor: 流传着这样的古老俗语，日暮时分，不要去排列着怨影娃娃的房子。
353.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
353.flavorEn: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

354.flavor: 因被丢弃的怨念而诞生。听说，如果满足它受重视的需求，就会变回原来的玩偶。
354.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
354.flavorEn: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

355.flavor: 会让身体变透明，然后偷偷地靠近猎物。拥有穿过厚墙壁的能力。
355.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
355.flavorEn: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

356.flavor: 寻找游走的灵魂，吸入自己空洞的身体里。没人知道被吸入后会发生什么事。
356.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
356.flavorEn: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

357.flavor: 脖子上的那串水果很美味，很受欢迎。在温暖的地方，有许多培育热带龙的牧场。
357.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
357.flavorEn: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.
357.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

358.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
358.flavorEn: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

359.flavor: 由于拥有感知危险的能力，因此它被人们误解为是会招来灾祸的宝可梦。
359.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
359.flavorEn: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.
359.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

360.flavor: 具有集体行动的习性。睡觉的时候会聚集在洞窟中，和伙伴们把身体挨在一起。
360.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
360.flavorEn: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

361.flavor: 只能在寒冷的土地上生存。即使在零下100度的环境下也能充满活力地到处蹦蹦跳跳。
361.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
361.flavorEn: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.
361.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

362.flavor: 用令空气中的水分瞬间冻结的力量，将猎物冰冻起来。
362.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
362.flavorEn: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.
362.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

363.flavor: 会漂浮在波浪当中观察大海的状况。一旦发现猎物，就会通知群体里的帝牙海狮。
363.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
363.flavorEn: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.
363.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

364.flavor: 不管是海豹球还是精灵球，只要是圆的物体都会顶在鼻子上转来转去。
364.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
364.flavorEn: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.
364.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

365.flavor: 它的獠牙一生都会持续生长。即使在战斗中被折断也能逐渐恢复，只需要1年的时间便能完好如初。
365.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
365.flavorEn: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.
365.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

366.flavor: 珍珠贝的珍珠非常贵重。据说，其价值或许是大舌贝珍珠的10倍以上。
366.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
366.flavorEn: Clamperl's pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder's pearls.
366.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

367.flavor: 栖息在深海中。传说，如果猎斑鱼被冲上沙滩，就会有不祥的事情发生。
367.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
367.flavorEn: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.
367.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

368.flavor: 吸食猎物的体液。剩下的肉会沉入海底，成为其他宝可梦的食物。
368.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
368.flavorEn: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.
368.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

369.flavor: 在深海调查中被发现的宝可梦。样子在1亿年间都没有任何变化，被人们称为活化石。
369.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
369.flavorEn: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn't changed in 100,000,000 years, so it's called a living fossil.
369.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

370.flavor: 温暖海域的珊瑚礁是它的栖息地。特别喜欢在太阳珊瑚的枝条间睡觉。
370.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
370.flavorEn: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.
370.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

371.flavor: 不会成群结队，喜欢单独生活。脑袋很硬，只要猛地一撞，就能把坚硬的岩石一分为二。
371.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
371.flavorEn: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn't form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.
371.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

372.flavor: 可以不吃食物忍受饥饿。据说当它用尽积蓄的能量后，就会开始进化。
372.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
372.flavorEn: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.
372.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

373.flavor: 虽然在空中翱翔能够让它乐在其中，但是一旦被惹怒，就会大闹一番，不可收拾。
373.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
373.flavorEn: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.
373.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

374.flavor: 身体的细胞由磁铁构成。循环于全身的不是血液，而是磁力。
374.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
374.flavorEn: The cells in this Pokémon's body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum's body.

375.flavor: 依靠磁力飞行。能够在空中以高速穿过险峻的山岳，让追捕的猎物无处可逃。
375.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
375.flavorEn: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

376.flavor: 2只金属怪组合起来的样子。运用堪比超级计算机的头脑打败敌人。
376.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
376.flavorEn: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

377.flavor: 人们通过最新的科学技术对它的岩石身体做了调查，但是并未发现大脑和心脏。
377.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
377.flavorEn: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon's rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.
377.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

378.flavor: 拥有一副由冰构成的身体。据说是诞生于冰河时期冻得厚厚实实的冰块之下。
378.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
378.flavorEn: This Pokémon's body is made of solid ice. It's said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.
378.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

379.flavor: 据说诞生于地幔之中，在距今约1万年前现身于地面之上。
379.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
379.flavorEn: It's rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet's mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

380.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
380.flavorEn: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.
380.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

381.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
381.flavorEn: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.
381.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

382.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
382.flavorEn: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
382.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

383.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
383.flavorEn: Through Primal Reversion and with nature's full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.
383.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

384.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
384.flavorEn: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.
384.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

385.flavor: 传说当它从1000年的沉睡中醒来时，会实现写在它头部许愿笺上的愿望。
385.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
385.flavorEn: It's believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.

386.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
386.flavorEn: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

387.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
387.flavorEn: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.
387.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

388.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
388.flavorEn: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.
388.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

389.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
389.flavorEn: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.
389.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

390.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
390.flavorEn: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name "Lantern-Tail" and feared as some kind of apparition.

391.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
391.flavorEn: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

392.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
392.flavorEn: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

393.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
393.flavorEn: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.
393.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

394.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
394.flavorEn: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.
394.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

395.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
395.flavorEn: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.
395.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

396.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
396.flavorEn: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

397.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
397.flavorEn: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

398.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
398.flavorEn: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

399.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
399.flavorEn: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

400.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
400.flavorEn: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

401.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
401.flavorEn: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.
401.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

402.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
402.flavorEn: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.
402.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

403.flavor: 体毛通电后就会发光。会摇晃明亮发光的尾巴尖端来向伙伴发送信号。
403.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
403.flavorEn: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.
403.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

404.flavor: 遇到敌人时会从脚伸出有着百万伏特威力的爪子来迎战。
404.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
404.flavorEn: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.
404.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

405.flavor: 由于透视需要消耗大量的电能，因此它会睡很长时间来积蓄能量。
405.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
405.flavorEn: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.
405.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

406.flavor: 对气温的变化很敏感。当它开始打开花苞，便是冬去春来之时。
406.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
406.flavorEn: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.
406.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

407.flavor: 右手的毒是速效的，左手的毒则是慢性的。无论哪边的毒性都能致命。
407.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
407.flavorEn: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.
407.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

408.flavor: 坚硬的头盖骨是其特征。会用头锤撞断树木，吃树上结的树果。
408.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
408.flavorEn: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.
408.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

409.flavor: 擅长头锤的古代宝可梦。因为大脑真的很小，所以也有说法它是因愚笨而灭亡的。
409.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
409.flavorEn: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.
409.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

410.flavor: 虽然从太古时代的地层中发现了它的化石，但尚未发现除了脸以外的部分。
410.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
410.flavorEn: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.
410.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

411.flavor: 大约1亿年前的宝可梦。极其结实的脸有着超越钢铁的硬度。
411.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
411.flavorEn: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.
411.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

412.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
412.flavorEn: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.
412.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

413.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
413.flavorEn: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.
413.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

414.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
414.flavorEn: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.
414.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

415.flavor: 从早到晚都在采集花蜜。这一切都是为了自己的族群和蜂女王。
415.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
415.flavorEn: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.
415.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

416.flavor: 能释放越多费洛蒙的蜂女王，就能让越多的三蜜蜂听从自己的指挥。
416.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
416.flavorEn: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.
416.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

417.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
417.flavorEn: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.
417.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

418.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
418.flavorEn: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.
418.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

419.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
419.flavorEn: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.
419.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

420.flavor: 身体越红的樱花宝含有的营养越丰富，味道也很甜很好吃。
420.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
420.flavorEn: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.
420.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

421.flavor: 盖起来的花瓣很硬。即使被鸟宝可梦啄到，也完全没问题。
421.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
421.flavorEn: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.
421.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

422.flavor: 如果用力按住它，它就会分泌出神秘的紫色液体。虽然液体无害，不过黏糊糊的。
422.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
422.flavorEn: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!
422.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

423.flavor: 身体软瘫瘫的但十分强韧。因为它身体的软度可以帮助分散它所受到的冲击。
423.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
423.flavorEn: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.
423.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

424.flavor: 无论做什么都会用到尾巴。如果被它的2条尾巴抱紧，那就证明是真的和你很亲近。
424.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
424.flavorEn: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

425.flavor: 因魂魄聚集在一起而诞生。到了湿气大的季节就有可能大量出现。
425.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
425.flavorEn: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

426.flavor: 会抓住人和宝可梦，然后运到某个地方。没人知道那地方是哪里。
426.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
426.flavorEn: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

427.flavor: 会利用把卷卷的耳朵伸直时产生的威力进行攻击。越训练，这一招式的威力就越强。
427.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
427.flavorEn: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

428.flavor: 当高温的季节结束后，就会换上富含空气的体毛，准备抵御寒冷。
428.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
428.flavorEn: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

429.flavor: 会吟诵诅咒的语言，让对方极度头疼，或是看到恐怖的幻觉，深受折磨。
429.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
429.flavorEn: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

430.flavor: 和敌人战斗的基本都是跟班。只有在最后刺入对手的致命一击才会弄脏自己的手。
430.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
430.flavorEn: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.
430.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

431.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
431.flavorEn: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

432.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
432.flavorEn: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

433.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
433.flavorEn: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

434.flavor: 要是它翘起尾巴把屁股对准了你，请一定要小心。因为这表示它将要喷出足以让人窒息的臭液。
434.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
434.flavorEn: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

435.flavor: 从尾巴尖端喷出的液体带有强烈的恶臭。会在地面上挖洞建造巢穴。
435.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
435.flavorEn: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

436.flavor: 虽然人们说把铜镜怪打磨到发光，它就能映照出真相，但其实它非常讨厌被打磨。
436.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
436.flavorEn: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

437.flavor: 它身上的纹路让许多学者都认为它原本并不存在于伽勒尔。
437.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
437.flavorEn: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

438.flavor: 栖息在空气干燥岩石裸露的地方。空气越是干燥，它身上的绿球就越是会泛出暗淡的光泽。
438.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
438.flavorEn: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.
438.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

439.flavor: 像徒弟一样跟随着擅长跳舞的踏冰人偶，拼命模仿它的舞步。
439.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
439.flavorEn: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

440.flavor: 会把自己珍贵的浑圆石头借给关系变得很要好的对象。如果不还给它，它便会大哭大闹。
440.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
440.flavorEn: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

441.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
441.flavorEn: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

442.flavor: 总是作恶多端，于是被使用神奇法术的旅人绑缚在楔石里。
442.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
442.flavorEn: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

443.flavor: 遇到会动的东西就会扑上去将其拉回到自己住的横洞内。虽然嘴很大，但胃口却比较小。
443.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
443.flavorEn: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.
443.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

444.flavor: 会把宝石埋藏在栖息的洞窟内。入侵者闯入洞窟后，会立刻被它用爪子和牙齿撕碎。
444.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
444.flavorEn: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.
444.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

445.flavor: 身手在陆地上也很矫捷，在雪山上会赶在身体冻僵前干掉猎物并返回住处。
445.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
445.flavorEn: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.
445.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

446.flavor: 在体毛下面储存食物。如果是自己信赖的对象，也会把食物分给对方一口。
446.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
446.flavorEn: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

447.flavor: 除了能读懂对手的感情，也能以“波导”这种形式的波来观察大自然的样子。
447.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
447.flavorEn: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

448.flavor: 他能理解人类的想法，因此只会去亲近内心端正的训练家。
448.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
448.flavorEn: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name "aura" to this power.

449.flavor: 主要在白天活动。因为沙漠的夜晚会降温，所以会钻到沙子的深处睡觉。
449.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
449.flavorEn: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.
449.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

450.flavor: 生气的时候非常凶暴。会喷出储存在体内的沙子来引发沙尘暴。
450.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
450.flavorEn: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.
450.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

451.flavor: 用尾巴上带毒的钩爪袭击对手。一旦被夹住，毒素就会扩散开来，导致全身无法动弹。
451.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
451.flavorEn: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

452.flavor: 虽然狰狞凶猛到被人们称为沙之恶魔，但在河马兽面前却表现得低调温顺。
452.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
452.flavorEn: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

453.flavor: 毒素在稀释后能制成药品。它是制药公司的吉祥物，广受众人的欢迎。
453.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
453.flavorEn: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

454.flavor: 制服了猎物之后，便会呱呱地发出胜利的欢呼。与蟾蜍王是相近的物种。
454.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
454.flavorEn: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

455.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
455.flavorEn: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.
455.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

456.flavor: 用发光的尾鳍引诱猎物。白天会在海面附近，到了夜里就向海的深处移动。
456.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
456.flavorEn: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it.
456.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

457.flavor: 像是爬行一样在深海的海底游泳。鳍上发出的充满幻想的光就像是夜空的星星。
457.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
457.flavorEn: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.
457.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

458.flavor: 混在铁炮鱼的大群里游泳。受到敌人袭击的时候，会和铁炮鱼们并肩作战。
458.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
458.flavorEn: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.
458.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

459.flavor: 雪笠怪肚子上结出来的口感好似冰棍的树果是伽勒尔的火红不倒翁们的最爱。
459.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
459.flavorEn: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.
459.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

460.flavor: 会引发暴风雪的宝可梦。只要它摇动巨大的身体，周围立刻会变得一片雪白。
460.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
460.flavorEn: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.
460.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

461.flavor: 通过用爪子留下记号来与伙伴联络。据说记号的种类有500种以上。
461.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
461.flavorEn: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.
461.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

462.flavor: 人们认为，它是因为受到特殊磁场的影响，身体的分子构造发生了变化，才进化成这样的。
462.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
462.flavorEn: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.
462.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

463.flavor: 舌头的灵巧程度甚至不输给人手，没有它做不到的事。相反，手指却相当笨拙，
