537.flavorEn: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.
537.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

538.flavor: 5只一组一起努力练习。在练习中掉队的投摔鬼会扔掉带子离开团队。
538.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
538.flavorEn: They train in groups of five. Any member that can't keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

539.flavor: 不断重复练习的打击鬼所使出的空手劈拥有足以劈开大海的破坏力。
539.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
539.flavorEn: The karate chops of a Sawk that's trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

540.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
540.flavorEn: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
540.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

541.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
541.flavorEn: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
541.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

542.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
542.flavorEn: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
542.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

543.flavor: 牙齿上有剧毒。一旦发现看上去能吃的猎物，就会不假思索地扑上去。
543.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
543.flavorEn: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.
543.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

544.flavor: 用坚硬的壳和带毒的刺保护自己的身体，积蓄进化所需的能量。
544.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
544.flavorEn: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it'll need for evolution.
544.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

545.flavor: 会和焚焰蚣激烈地争夺领地。输掉的那一方会成为另一方的猎物。
545.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
545.flavorEn: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.
545.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

546.flavor: 将木棉球和白蓬蓬的棉花混合后编织出的布料极其精致，因此常被高级品牌选用。
546.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
546.flavorEn: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that's highly prized by many luxury brands.
546.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

547.flavor: 每当沐浴阳光，身上的棉花就会膨胀。如果膨胀过了头，它就会把棉花扯开到处乱撒。
547.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
547.flavorEn: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.
547.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

548.flavor: 叶子的颜色越深就越健康。有时也会在被精心照料过的田地或花坛里定居下来。
548.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
548.flavorEn: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.
548.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

549.flavor: 用它的花朵制成的精油虽有着极致香气，但价格同时也贵得令人大跌眼镜。
549.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
549.flavorEn: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
549.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

550.flavor: 从前也曾经登上餐桌。红条纹野蛮鲈鱼的肉脂肪含量高，适合年轻人食用。
550.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
550.flavorEn: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
550.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

551.flavor: 个头虽小，腰腿却很有力。会拨开沙子，在沙漠里犹如游泳般地自在移动。
551.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
551.flavorEn: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it's swimming.
551.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

552.flavor: 虽然拥有能在黑暗中看清事物的特殊双眼，但由于沙漠的夜晚寒冷，所以一般不怎么活动。
552.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
552.flavorEn: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won't move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.
552.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

553.flavor: 虽然凶暴，但也有擅长忍耐的一面。为了捕获猎物，可以在沙子里静静等上好几天。
553.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
553.flavorEn: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.
553.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

554.flavor: 在它睡觉的时候，无论是推是拉，它都不会倒下。因为象征着吉利而大受欢迎。
554.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
554.flavorEn: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

555.flavor: 体内的火焰燃得越旺，力量就越大。火焰的温度有时甚至能超过1400度。
555.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
555.flavorEn: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

556.flavor: 一年散播一次种子。花的种子营养十足，是沙漠中贵重的食粮。
556.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
556.flavorEn: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.
556.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

557.flavor: 如果找不到大小合适的石头来当成自己的家，它也会住到河马兽的洞里。
557.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
557.flavorEn: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.
557.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

558.flavor: 厚实的钳子是它最大的武器。硬度高到甚至能让超甲狂犀的护具裂开。
558.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
558.flavorEn: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.
558.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

559.flavor: 用结实的皮保护身体。据说在皮伸展到极限时，它就会开始进化。
559.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
559.flavorEn: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.
559.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

560.flavor: 虽然性格非常粗鲁，但也有重视家族、伙伴和领地的另一面。
560.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
560.flavorEn: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.
560.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

561.flavor: 人们在象征鸟飞过的沙漠的地下调查，结果在那里发现了疑似古代都市的遗迹。
561.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
561.flavorEn: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

562.flavor: 古代人的灵魂变成了宝可梦。为了寻找认得自己长相的人而在遗迹里徘徊。
562.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
562.flavorEn: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

563.flavor: 迭失棺象征着国王的财富，因此许多古墓里都有它的壁画。
563.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
563.flavorEn: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They're symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

564.flavor: 由化石复活的宝可梦。人们认为它是很多龟宝可梦的祖先。
564.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
564.flavorEn: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.
564.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

565.flavor: 虽然和在水中相比动作会变得迟缓，但是为了寻找猎物也会登上陆地活动。
565.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
565.flavorEn: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.
565.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

566.flavor: 被称为鸟宝可梦的祖先。栖息在树上，以树果和虫宝可梦为食。
566.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
566.flavorEn: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.
566.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

567.flavor: 虽然也会飞行，但是似乎更擅长在地面上捕捉猎物。
567.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
567.flavorEn: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.
567.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

568.flavor: 诞生于塞满垃圾的垃圾袋里。它嘴里喷出的毒气是伽勒尔双弹瓦斯的最爱。
568.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
568.flavorEn: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

569.flavor: 从右臂喷出的毒液十分危险，虚弱的生物只要一沾到，立刻就会丢掉性命。
569.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
569.flavorEn: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

570.flavor: 为了寻找食物，有时甚至会幻化成人类出现在城镇里。多数情况下会幻化成小孩。
570.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
570.flavorEn: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
570.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

571.flavor: 孤独的训练家会命令索罗亚克为自己展现幻像，借以排遣孤身一人的寂寞。
571.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
571.flavorEn: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.
571.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

572.flavor: 用尾巴互相抚摸来打招呼。尾巴的毛比较蓬松的那一方会表现得稍微威风些。
572.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
572.flavorEn: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

573.flavor: 覆盖着特别油脂的毛发可以挡住攻击。这种油以高价在市场上流通。
573.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
573.flavorEn: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

574.flavor: 哥德宝宝会在看似无人的地方轻声地叫。它好像是在与某种只有它才看得见的东西说话。
574.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
574.flavorEn: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it's speaking to something only it can see.

575.flavor: 哥德小童的精神力量似乎会在星光闪耀的夜晚达到最高点。它与宇宙的关系至今不明。
575.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
575.flavorEn: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon's psychic power is at its strongest. It's unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

576.flavor: 从哥德小姐那里看到了自己下场的恶人在那之后便销声匿迹了。
576.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
576.flavorEn: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

577.flavor: 身体被特殊的液体包裹着，许多人因此认为它即使在宇宙中也能存活。
577.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
577.flavorEn: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon's body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

578.flavor: 由于它一分为二的大脑思考的内容几乎完全不同，导致它的行动非常难以预测。
578.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
578.flavorEn: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

579.flavor: 虽然有人说只要喝掉它特殊的液体就能得到智慧，但对人造细胞卵以外来说，那其实是剧毒。
579.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
579.flavorEn: It's said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

580.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
580.flavorEn: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
580.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

581.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
581.flavorEn: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
581.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

582.flavor: 据说它是从冰柱中诞生的。为了能让自己生活得更舒适，会吐出零下50度的冷气冻住四周。
582.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
582.flavorEn: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.
582.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

583.flavor: 性格和善，虽然会用零下100度的冷气冻住敌人，但并不会伤及它们的性命。
583.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
583.flavorEn: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it's a kind Pokémon.
583.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

584.flavor: 体温在零下6度左右。据说是由2只多多冰贴在一起而诞生的。
584.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
584.flavorEn: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.
584.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

585.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
585.flavorEn: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

586.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
586.flavorEn: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

587.flavor: 最喜欢甜甜的树果。有时也会因为在脸颊的袋子里囤了太多食物而无法好好飞行。
587.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
587.flavorEn: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can't fly properly.
587.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

588.flavor: 用嘴里吐出的液体来溶化小嘴蜗的壳，只会去吃里面的身体。
588.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
588.flavorEn: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet's shell. Karrablast doesn't eat the shell— it eats only the contents.
588.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

589.flavor: 会举起长矛突击敌人。有一幅名画描绘着它和葱游兵决斗的场景。
589.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
589.flavorEn: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch'd.
589.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

590.flavor: 从双手喷出的孢子虽然含有剧毒，但据说彻底干燥后可以用作治疗肠胃的药。
590.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
590.flavorEn: The spores released from this Pokémon's hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.
590.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

591.flavor: 平常一般不太动。只是一动不动地待在掉落于地面的精灵球旁边。
591.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
591.flavorEn: Amoonguss generally doesn't move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.
591.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

592.flavor: 据流传至今的传说里所述，它是由沉没到海底的古代都市的居民变成的宝可梦。
592.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
592.flavorEn: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.
592.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

593.flavor: 每到满月时，胖嘟嘟会成群结队地来到海面上。这么做是为了等待猎物上门。
593.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
593.flavorEn: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.
593.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

594.flavor: 之所以会救助体弱的宝可梦，好像是因为盯上它们的宝可梦也会攻击它自己。
594.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
594.flavorEn: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.
594.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

595.flavor: 会附在其他宝可梦身上吸取静电。经常会把自己贴在来电汪的屁股上。
595.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
595.flavorEn: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They're often found sticking to Yamper's hindquarters.
595.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

596.flavor: 为了捕捉不太会飞的幼鸟，会在鸟宝可梦的巢穴附近用带电的丝设下陷阱。
596.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
596.flavorEn: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.
596.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

597.flavor: 偏爱长着青苔的洞窟。青苔中所含的酶能使它的尖刺成长得又大又结实。
597.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
597.flavorEn: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed's spikes grow big and strong.
597.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

598.flavor: 拥有比钢铁还坚硬的尖刺。会利用触手上的尖刺攀附在岩壁上移动。
598.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
598.flavorEn: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.
598.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

599.flavor: 据说在很久以前，是看到了齿轮儿的人发明了齿轮的构造。
599.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
599.flavorEn: It's suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people's invention of the first gears.

600.flavor: 被认为是工业技术的象征。有许多伽勒尔当地的公司选择它作为企业的标志。
600.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
600.flavorEn: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

601.flavor: 让3个齿轮高速旋转。新增出来的那个带着尖刺的齿轮并不是生物。
601.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
601.flavorEn: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn't a living creature.

602.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
602.flavorEn: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
602.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

603.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
603.flavorEn: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
603.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

604.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
604.flavorEn: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
604.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

605.flavor: 在大约50年前被发现的宝可梦。会用又大又发达的大脑操纵精神力量。
605.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
605.flavorEn: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

606.flavor: 能控制对方的记忆。经常有人看到它在麦田的上方徘徊。
606.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
606.flavorEn: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

607.flavor: 吸取到的灵魂越年轻，头上的烛光就会燃烧得越旺越诡异。
607.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
607.flavorEn: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

608.flavor: 伪装成灯的样子藏身在城镇里。一旦发现了临近死期的人，便会悄悄地跟在后面。
608.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
608.flavorEn: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

609.flavor: 据说在用水晶灯火灵来充当照明设备的房子里，丧事会接连不断。
609.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
609.flavorEn: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it's said.

610.flavor: 会和伙伴们一起互撞牙齿来玩。折断的牙齿会马上长出来，所以丝毫都不会去在意。
610.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
610.flavorEn: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn't a concern.
610.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

611.flavor: 皮肤像盔甲一样坚硬。非常擅长在撞击的同时用牙齿猛刺的战法。
611.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
611.flavorEn: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure's favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.
611.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

612.flavor: 性格温和，但生起气来非常恐怖。会用自己那引以为傲，可以削铁如泥的牙齿攻击敌人。
612.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
612.flavorEn: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.
612.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

613.flavor: 使出招式前会先倒吸鼻涕。鼻涕里所含有的强烈冷气是冰属性招式的能量来源。
613.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
613.flavorEn: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.
613.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

614.flavor: 在冰冷的大海里精力十足地游泳。感到疲劳的时候会吐出气息冻结海水，在冰面上休息。
614.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
614.flavorEn: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.
614.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

615.flavor: 天气一热就会化为水蒸气。到了夏天几乎到处都看不到它的踪影。
615.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
615.flavorEn: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.
615.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

616.flavor: 有着会对电能产生反应的奇异体质。不知为何，和盖盖虫待在一起就会进化。
616.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
616.flavorEn: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.
616.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

617.flavor: 脱壳后变得更轻巧了。为了防止干燥，会将带状的粘膜裹在身上。
617.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
617.flavorEn: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.
617.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

618.flavor: 当从身上的黄色斑纹里释放出强大电流时，它会莫名地露出微笑。
618.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
618.flavorEn: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.
618.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

619.flavor: 个头虽小脾气却很暴躁。面对疏忽大意接近自己的对手，会施展出华丽的连击。
619.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
619.flavorEn: Though small, Mienfoo's temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

620.flavor: 以迅雷不及掩耳的速度使出踢击，即使是巨大的岩石也能击得粉碎。
620.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
620.flavorEn: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

621.flavor: 性情凶暴而狡猾。会把其他宝可梦挖出的巢穴抢来当做自己的住处。
621.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
621.flavorEn: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.
621.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

622.flavor: 用黏土制成的宝可梦。即使现在也一直遵循着数千年前主人的命令。
622.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
622.flavorEn: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.
622.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

623.flavor: 虽然有人认为它体内有着生成能量的永动机，但至今仍未得到证实。
623.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
623.flavorEn: There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.
623.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

624.flavor: 以劈斩司令为首领组成族群。目标是有朝一日能统领同类，所以每天都在不懈地锻炼。
624.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
624.flavorEn: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.
624.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

625.flavor: 为了抢占能找到磨刀石的地方，和斧牙龙展开了激烈的斗争。
625.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
625.flavorEn: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.
625.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

626.flavor: 会以约20只的规模群居。不知为何，背叛了族群的爆炸头水牛脑袋上的毛会脱落。
626.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
626.flavorEn: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

627.flavor: 握力强，能把坚硬的树果弄得粉碎。性急爱吵架，无论对谁都会挑起战斗。
627.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
627.flavorEn: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

628.flavor: 性格粗暴、血气方刚，因此被钢铠鸦夺走了伽勒尔运送员的地位。
628.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
628.flavorEn: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

629.flavor: 由于很快就会长大，屁股上的骸骨会接着传给巢里更小的秃鹰丫头用。
629.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
629.flavorEn: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.
629.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

630.flavor: 把捡来的骨头装饰在身上。在骨头形状这方面似乎也是有流行趋势的。
630.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
630.flavorEn: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.
630.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

631.flavor: 将火焰当成舌头来使用。会一点一点地熔化铁蚁坚硬的外骨骼，然后把它吃掉。
631.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
631.flavorEn: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

632.flavor: 巨大的颚部能咬碎岩石。为了不让沙螺蟒把蛋抢走，会和其他同类一起并肩战斗。
632.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
632.flavorEn: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
632.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

633.flavor: 因为眼睛看不见，所以会又撞又咬，来判断四周的状况。
633.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
633.flavorEn: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.
633.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

634.flavor: 2个头会争抢同一个食物。明明没有去和别人战斗，却总是遍体鳞伤。
634.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
634.flavorEn: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.
634.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

635.flavor: 3个头会轮流去咬敌人。在对方倒下之前，绝对不会停止攻击。
635.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
635.flavorEn: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.
635.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

636.flavor: 全身都相当温暖。会从角的尖端喷出火焰，借此威吓天敌或猎物。
636.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
636.flavorEn: Larvesta's body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.
636.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

637.flavor: 从熊熊燃烧的火焰之茧中诞生。在古代的壁画上被描绘为火之神。
637.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
637.flavorEn: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.
637.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

638.flavor: 生来就具有领导风范。即使是性格狂暴的宝可梦，在勾帕路翁面前也会变得温顺。
638.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
638.flavorEn: From the moment it's born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

639.flavor: 代拉基翁为保护宝可梦而与人类作战的传说在合众地区广为流传。
639.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
639.flavorEn: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.
639.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

640.flavor: 以敏捷的身手像旋风一般将敌人玩弄于股掌之中，会用锋利的角毫不留情地切斩对手。
640.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
640.flavorEn: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.
640.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

641.likes: 喜欢站在高处吹风，看到天空就想飞
641.flavorEn: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

642.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
642.flavorEn: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.
642.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

643.flavor: 在神话的叙述里，如果人类蔑视真实、放纵欲望，它就会用火焰烧尽他们的王国。
643.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
643.flavorEn: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.
643.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

644.flavor: 在神话的描述里，如果人类失去了正义之心，它就会用狂暴的雷电毁灭他们的王国。
644.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
644.flavorEn: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom's lightning.
644.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

645.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
645.flavorEn: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.
645.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

646.flavor: 为了稳定细胞组织，它似乎用自己制造出的冷气冰冻着身体。
646.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
646.flavorEn: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.
646.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

647.flavor: 据说当它挺过了艰难的战斗，额头上的角就能得到锻炼，从而激发出自己真正的力量。
647.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
647.flavorEn: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon's true power will awaken.
647.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

648.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
648.flavorEn: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

649.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
649.flavorEn: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
649.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

650.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
650.flavorEn: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.
650.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

651.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
651.flavorEn: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.
651.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

652.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
652.flavorEn: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
652.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

653.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
653.flavorEn: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

654.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
654.flavorEn: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

655.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
655.flavorEn: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

656.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
656.flavorEn: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
656.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

657.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
657.flavorEn: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.
657.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

658.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
658.flavorEn: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
658.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

659.flavor: 对危险很敏感。只要听到钢铠鸦拍打翅膀的声音，就会马上挖洞钻进地下藏身。
659.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
659.flavorEn: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

660.flavor: 肚子上的体毛保温性能优秀。在过去，人们会用它的落毛来制作保暖服装。
660.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
660.flavorEn: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

661.flavor: 一旦兴奋体温就会急剧上升。赤手去摸甚至有可能会被灼伤。
661.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
661.flavorEn: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

662.flavor: 领地意识很强，性格好战。火箭雀彼此之间会为了觅食的地方发生争斗。
662.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
662.flavorEn: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

663.flavor: 会以500公里的时速进行突击。不给猎物留下逃跑的机会，直接以猛烈的踢击将其解决。
663.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
663.flavorEn: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

664.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
664.flavorEn: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
664.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

665.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
665.flavorEn: The beaks of bird Pokémon can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.
665.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

666.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
666.flavorEn: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.
666.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

667.flavor: 血气方刚且好奇心旺盛。如果生气或是开始战斗，短短的鬃毛就会变热。
667.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
667.flavorEn: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

668.flavor: 会吐出摄氏6000度的气息，但不会用于猎物。因为更喜欢吃生的肉。
668.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
668.flavorEn: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

669.flavor: 头上的冠是收集花粉做成的。蕴藏着治愈的效果。
669.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
669.flavorEn: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

670.flavor: 把自己的力量给花，用心地照料。绝不原谅那些破坏花坛者。
670.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
670.flavorEn: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

671.flavor: 拥有几百年的寿命。据说会终其一生不断地守护着庭园。
671.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
671.flavorEn: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

672.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
672.flavorEn: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.
672.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

673.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
673.flavorEn: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
673.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

674.flavor: 为了不被小看而一直瞪着对手，然而绷紧的神经一旦稍有放松，它就会在无意中露出笑脸。
674.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
674.flavorEn: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

675.flavor: 通过叶子来洞悉敌人的动向。只要使出一记拳击就能让大型翻斗车变成废铁。
675.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
675.flavorEn: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

676.flavor: 如果置之不理，体毛会不断地长长，但只允许信赖的人修剪。
676.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
676.flavorEn: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

677.flavor: 虽然拥有可以弹飞职业摔角手的精神力量，却因无法好好控制而感到烦恼。
677.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
677.flavorEn: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

678.flavor: 雄性的防卫本能很强，在保护自己和伙伴时能发挥最大的威力。
678.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
678.flavorEn: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

679.flavor: 独剑鞘剑格上的蓝色眼珠是它的本体。会用陈旧的布吸取人类的精气。
679.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
679.flavorEn: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

680.flavor: 2把剑会用令人眼花缭乱的速度不断交替攻击和防御，借以制服猎物。
680.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
680.flavorEn: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

681.flavor: 坚盾剑怪曾经用强大的灵力控制人和宝可梦，建立了适合自己生活的国家。
681.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
681.flavorEn: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

682.flavor: 身上飘出的香气能让人们神魂颠倒。贵妇们对它钟爱万分。
682.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
682.flavorEn: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

683.flavor: 会发出恶臭让敌人丧失战意，或者发出芳香的味道来帮助自己的伙伴。
683.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
683.flavorEn: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent's will to fight.

684.flavor: 蓬松的体毛闻起来就像棉花糖一样甜甜的。会放出黏糊糊的丝缠住敌人。
684.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
684.flavorEn: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

685.flavor: 因为体毛里富含空气，所以摸起来十分柔软，重量也比看起来要轻。
685.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
685.flavorEn: Slurpuff's fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

686.flavor: 会让敌人看到自己闪烁的发光体来让对方丧失战意，然后趁机逃之夭夭。
686.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
686.flavorEn: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.
686.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

687.flavor: 据说那些能够改变历史的重大事件其实都和乌贼王的催眠能力有关。
687.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
687.flavorEn: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.
687.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

688.flavor: 如果2只龟脚脚配合得不好，不但无法有效地攻击和防御，甚至没办法生存下去。
688.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
688.flavorEn: If the two don't work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won't survive.
688.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

689.flavor: 用手掌上的眼珠来观察前后左右的状况。遇上危机时手脚会自己动起来打倒对手。
689.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
689.flavorEn: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy's defeat.
689.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

690.flavor: 看上去很像腐烂的海藻，因此会藏身于漂在海里的碎藻中，骗过敌人的眼睛。
690.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
690.flavorEn: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

691.flavor: 会通过将头上的伞状部分伸出海面吸收阳光的方式，在体内制造龙之能量。
691.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
691.flavorEn: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean's surface and bathing it in sunlight.

692.flavor: 通过引爆积蓄在右臂钳子中的气体，像发射子弹般将水喷射出去，击倒敌人。
692.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
692.flavorEn: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.
692.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

693.flavor: 右臂是能够喷射海水炮弹的大炮。威力大到足以击沉油轮。
693.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
693.flavorEn: Clawitzer's right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer's cannon arm can sink a tanker.
693.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

694.flavor: 拥有太阳能发电的结构。如果有人打扰它发电，它就会因心理压力而衰弱。
694.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
694.flavorEn: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.
694.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

695.flavor: 如果展开颈伞沐浴阳光，单凭1只光电伞蜥就能制造出大城市所需的电力。
695.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
695.flavorEn: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.
695.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

696.flavor: 又任性又爱撒娇。即使它只是闹着玩，也会让训练家受重伤。
696.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
696.flavorEn: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.
696.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

697.flavor: 如果被它的大颚咬到，连汽车都会变得粉碎。是古代世界的王者。
697.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
697.flavorEn: A single bite of Tyrantrum's massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.
697.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

698.flavor: 已经灭绝的古代宝可梦。有时候它还会以冰封的状态被发现喔。
698.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
698.flavorEn: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.
698.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

699.flavor: 当它被激怒时，就会喷出猛烈的冷气，把周围都冰封起来。
699.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
699.flavorEn: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.
699.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

700.flavor: 伽勒尔地区的童话中有着美丽的仙子伊布击退了可怕的龙宝可梦的故事。
700.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
700.flavorEn: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

701.flavor: 在使出致命的绝招之前一定要先摆出华丽的姿势。有时也会在这一刻遭到反击。
701.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
701.flavorEn: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

702.flavor: 由于发电的能力弱，会从插座或其他的电气宝可梦那里偷电。
702.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
702.flavorEn: Since Dedenne can't generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.
702.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

703.flavor: 据说在世界上的某处，有个沉睡着许多小碎钻的矿脉，它们的女王也在那里。
703.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
703.flavorEn: It's said that somewhere in the world, there's a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It's also said that this pack has a queen.
703.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

704.flavor: 它的触角是优秀的感觉器官。只要感觉到有敌人就会立刻藏起来，以此存活到了现在。
704.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
704.flavorEn: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.
704.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

705.flavor: 背上的突起物里装着它小小的脑子，里面只想着吃饭和逃离敌人这两件事。
705.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
705.flavorEn: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.
705.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

706.flavor: 用伸长角产生的力道来攻击对手，产生的威力比重量级拳击手的拳击还强100倍。
706.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
706.flavorEn: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.
706.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

707.flavor: 会用头的前端吸取金属离子。之所以长得像钥匙，据说是因为太过喜欢钥匙，情不自禁进行了模仿。
707.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
707.flavorEn: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

708.flavor: 用类似人类小孩的声音鸣叫，把大人引到森林的深处，让他们在其中迷失方向。
708.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
708.flavorEn: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

709.flavor: 脚尖伸出来的根须能连结森林中的树木，并且自由自在地加以操纵。
709.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
709.flavorEn: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

710.flavor: 南瓜的洞里发出的光会催眠并控制看到它的人和宝可梦。
710.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
710.flavorEn: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

711.flavor: 南瓜怪人会在朔月的夜里去别人家门口敲门。开了门的人会被它带往另一个世界。
711.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
711.flavorEn: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

712.flavor: 栖息在极其寒冷的地域。会把自己的脚冻在冰岩怪的背上固定起来。
712.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
712.flavorEn: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.
712.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

713.flavor: 虽然身体的裂缝会因白天的活动而变大，但只要一晚就能全部长好。
713.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
713.flavorEn: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
713.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

714.flavor: 可以控制所有频率的音波。就算是体型巨大的宝可梦，也对它的超音波束手无策。
714.likes: 喜欢站在高处吹风，看到天空就想飞
714.flavorEn: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat's ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

715.flavor: 在黑暗中一边飞行一边发出能粉碎岩石的超音波痛击敌人，然后用利齿给予致命的一击。
715.likes: 喜欢站在高处吹风，看到天空就想飞
715.flavorEn: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

716.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
716.flavorEn: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

717.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
717.flavorEn: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
717.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

718.flavor: 据说，在与威胁到生态系统者战斗时，它会变化为更强大的样子。
718.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
718.flavorEn: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
718.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

719.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
719.flavorEn: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
719.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

720.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
720.flavorEn: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

721.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
721.flavorEn: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

722.flavor: 白天利用光合作用积蓄力量，到了晚上则会悄无声息地在空中飞翔，寻找猎物。
722.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
722.flavorEn: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.
722.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

723.flavor: 对整理翅膀丝毫不会怠慢。这不单是因为它注重形象，也是为了让刃羽保持锐利。
723.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
723.flavorEn: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.
723.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

724.flavor: 只要0.1秒就可以在翅膀的藤蔓上搭好箭羽、射向敌人，并在敌人发现前贯穿其要害。
724.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
724.flavorEn: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
724.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

725.flavor: 如果在得到火斑喵的信任前就想抚摸它的话，要小心它用尖锐的爪子抓你。
725.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
725.flavorEn: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

726.flavor: 如果敌人实力强劲，它便会更有战斗的欲望，火焰铃铛的火力也会随之上升。
726.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
726.flavorEn: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat's fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

727.flavor: 虽然行为举止十分粗野，却也有着会去帮助弱小宝可梦的温柔一面。
727.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
727.flavorEn: Incineroar's rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

728.flavor: 每天拼命地练习，才终于能够制造出又大又好用的气球。
728.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
728.flavorEn: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.
728.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

729.flavor: 到了风平浪静的夜晚，会配合领队西狮海壬的歌声和伙伴们一起跳舞。
729.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
729.flavorEn: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that's leading them.
729.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

730.flavor: 对战就是西狮海壬的舞台。它那歌声和舞动气球的样子使观战的人们为之倾倒。
730.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
730.flavorEn: For Primarina, every battle's a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.
730.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

731.flavor: 拥有看着很细，却很强韧的颈部肌肉。能以每秒16连击的速度猛啄树木。
731.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
731.flavorEn: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

732.flavor: 会将吃掉的树果种子从口中射出。种子散落在大地上，新的草木便会生长出来。
732.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
732.flavorEn: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

733.flavor: 因成双成对感情和睦而闻名。它被视为一种吉祥的象征，常被带到结婚仪式去。
733.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
733.flavorEn: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

734.flavor: 什么都吃，但喜欢吃新鲜的活物。所以会为了寻找猎物在路上四处游走。
734.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
734.flavorEn: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

735.flavor: 忍耐力非常强，但如果见到它爱吃的小拉达，就会忘乎所以地扑过去。
735.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
735.flavorEn: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

736.flavor: 会用巨大的颚部在森林中挖地制造巢穴。最喜欢甜甜的树汁。
736.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
736.flavorEn: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.
736.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

737.flavor: 虫电宝消化吃掉的落叶时会产生电能。它会把这些电能储存在自己肚子上的电囊中。
737.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
737.flavorEn: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.
737.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

738.flavor: 如果它在飞翔时把虫电宝抱住当作备用电池，就能连续发射电力超高的电磁光束。
738.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
738.flavorEn: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.
738.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

739.flavor: 有时会把椰蛋树错认为椰子树而爬上去。惹怒椰蛋树后被抖落下来，并遭到踩踏。
739.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
739.flavorEn: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

740.flavor: 比起思考，会先试着打打看。曾经有过用拳头猛攻打退雪崩的记录。
740.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
740.flavorEn: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

741.flavor: 吸食了朱红色花蜜的花舞鸟。训练家弄错指示的话就会非常生气。是情感变化非常剧烈的家伙。
741.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
741.flavorEn: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

742.flavor: 从敌人散发出的气场来判断对方下一步的行动。能轻盈地躲开攻击并进行反击。
742.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
742.flavorEn: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.
742.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

743.flavor: 最讨厌雨水弄湿自己。因为伽勒尔地区阴天居多，所以很难见得到它的身影。
743.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
743.flavorEn: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.
743.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

744.flavor: 将脖子上的岩石向地面发射，以此威吓对手。在对方畏缩的刹那发起袭击。
744.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
744.flavorEn: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.
744.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

745.flavor: 会用敏捷的动作将猎物一点一点逼入绝境。利齿总是瞄准着对方的要害。
745.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
745.flavorEn: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc's fangs are always aimed toward opponents' weak spots.
745.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

746.flavor: 感觉到危险时眼睛就会变得湿润。眼泪的光亮会成为召集伙伴的信号，让许多的弱丁鱼聚在一起。
746.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
746.flavorEn: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.
746.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

747.flavor: 和阿罗拉的好坏星不同，伽勒尔的好坏星还没发现到太阳珊瑚的枝有多好吃。
747.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
747.flavorEn: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

748.flavor: 体内的毒囊中储存着满满的剧毒，毒性强到能让吼鲸王都痛苦三天三夜。
748.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
748.flavorEn: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

749.flavor: 在把自己吃土制造出的泥巴涂在脚上之后，无论走在路况多么差的路上都不会打滑。
749.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
749.flavorEn: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.
749.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

750.flavor: 拥有很强的耐力，可以不眠不休地拉着10吨重的货物纵贯伽勒尔地区。
750.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
750.flavorEn: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.
750.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

751.flavor: 平时生活在水中，也会戴上水泡去陆地上寻找食物。
751.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
751.flavorEn: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.
751.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

752.flavor: 把滴蛛放进头上的水泡里，一边喂它吃剩的食物，一边照顾它。
752.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
752.flavorEn: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.
752.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

753.flavor: 白天沐浴阳光，呼呼大睡。到了半夜才醒来并开始活动。
753.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
753.flavorEn: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.
753.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

754.flavor: 双臂的花瓣既薄又锋利。还能够积蓄阳光发射光束。
754.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
754.flavorEn: The petals on this Pokémon's arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.
754.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

755.flavor: 白天也生活在昏暗的森林里。会一边闪烁一边散播发光的孢子来让敌人陷入沉睡。
755.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
755.flavorEn: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.
755.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

756.flavor: 如果大半夜在森林的深处看见光亮，记住千万不要接近。灯罩夜菇会让你睡着的。
756.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
756.flavorEn: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don't go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.
756.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

757.flavor: 悄悄地从背后靠近猎物，在对方察觉之前释放毒气，让对方动弹不得。
757.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
757.flavorEn: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

758.flavor: 据说焰后蜥之间在争斗时，是通过比拼谁带着更多只雄性夜盗火蜥来定胜负的。
758.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
758.flavorEn: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

759.flavor: 为了保护自己的身体而胡乱挥舞前脚的样子虽然可爱，威力却大到能将大树折断。
759.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
759.flavorEn: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

760.flavor: 会用令格斗家都无地自容的技术把逮住的猎物夹在腋下，带回自己的住处。
760.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
760.flavorEn: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

761.flavor: 受到袭击时流下的汗水非常甜美可口。那种香气会吸引更多敌人的注意。
761.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
761.flavorEn: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.
761.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

762.flavor: 会用头部的壳盖击打飞来啄食自己的蓝鸦，并且对它使出猛烈的踢击。
762.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
762.flavorEn: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.
762.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

763.flavor: 用又尖又硬的脚尖施展脚踢，朝对手的身体和心灵留下无法磨灭的创伤。
763.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
763.flavorEn: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.
763.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

764.flavor: 散发着迷人香气的宝可梦。由于每只花疗环环身上的花都不一样，所以香味也各不相同。
764.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
764.flavorEn: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

765.flavor: 对森林的各个角落都了如指掌。如果有宝可梦受伤了，就会去寻找药草为它们治疗。
765.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
765.flavorEn: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

766.flavor: 20几只形成团队来生活。靠着每个成员明确的分工，在严苛的大自然中生存下来。
766.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
766.flavorEn: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

767.flavor: 成群聚集，随时提高警惕。只要察觉到有敌人，就会分散开来四处逃窜。
767.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
767.flavorEn: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.
767.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

768.flavor: 生活在海底的洞窟或沉船里。会去和八爪武师决战，输掉的一方便会成为对方的食物。
768.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
768.flavorEn: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner's meal.
768.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

769.flavor: 主要栖息在沙滩上。操纵把手伸进自己嘴里的对手，从而让自己变得更大。
769.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
769.flavorEn: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

770.flavor: 虽然住在沙滩上，但是讨厌水。要是淋了大雨，就无法维持城堡的造型。
770.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
770.flavorEn: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can't maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

771.flavor: 覆盖着皮肤的粘液具有出众的保湿效果，即使在陆地上待好几天也不会干掉。
771.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
771.flavorEn: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.
771.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

772.flavor: 以神话中的宝可梦为原型所创造出的宝可梦，被戴上了抑制力量失控的面罩。
772.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
772.flavorEn: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

773.flavor: 与所信赖的训练家之间的牵绊是解放它真正力量的最后一个要素。
773.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
773.flavorEn: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

774.flavor: 外壳非常坚固，但落到地上的冲击会让它碎成细屑。
774.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
774.flavorEn: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.
774.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

775.flavor: 到死都一直是睡着的状态，是因为吃的叶子里含有类似麻醉药的成分。
775.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
775.flavorEn: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

776.flavor: 在火山上生活，吃下的硫磺就是甲壳上炸药的原料。连粪便也会爆炸，十分危险。
776.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
776.flavorEn: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

777.flavor: 在危急时刻会把身体卷成一团，倒竖起背上的尖刺，不分青红皂白地发出电击。
777.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
777.flavorEn: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
777.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

778.flavor: 有一位学者为了研究而看了它的破布里面，结果患上怪病而离开人世。
778.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
778.flavorEn: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu's old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

779.flavor: 厚实的皮肤连好坏星的针也穿不透。会用结实的牙齿嘎嘣嘎嘣地咬碎针吃下去。
779.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
779.flavorEn: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.
779.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

780.flavor: 心地善良爱亲近人，但只要生气就会刮起强风吹倒一切。
780.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
780.flavorEn: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

781.flavor: 把锚抛到海里，伏击猎物。会去捕捉巨大的吼鲸王，吸取它们的精气。
781.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
781.flavorEn: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

782.flavor: 体毛变成了像金属一般坚硬的鳞片。通过敲击鳞片来和伙伴交流。
782.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
782.flavorEn: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that's become as hard as metal.
782.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

783.flavor: 敲响鳞片，发出吼声，接着向对手发起挑战，并用锋利的爪子撕裂对手。
783.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
783.flavorEn: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.
783.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

784.flavor: 遗迹壁画中古代战士身上穿着的盔甲是用杖尾鳞甲龙的鳞片制成的。
784.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
784.flavorEn: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
784.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

785.flavor: 操纵雷的美乐美乐的守护神。好奇心旺盛，会时不时在人们面前现身。
785.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
785.flavorEn: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
785.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

786.flavor: 被称为守护神，却兼有天真无邪与残酷的性格，被誉为自然的化身。
786.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
786.flavorEn: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

787.flavor: 会鸣响尾巴，告知自己的居所，以避免不必要的战争。是操纵草木的乌拉乌拉的守护神。
787.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
787.flavorEn: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula'ula controls plants.
787.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

788.flavor: 被称为守护神，但有时会给随便靠近的对方带去恐怖的灾难。
788.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
788.flavorEn: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
788.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

789.flavor: 没有警戒心且好奇心强，所以经常会遇到麻烦。危急时会用瞬间移动来逃跑。
789.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
789.flavorEn: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

790.flavor: 以惊人的气势吸入大气中的尘埃，努力用内核制造着进化的能源。
790.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
790.flavorEn: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

791.flavor: 曾经被称为吞食太阳之兽。能释放出无尽的光能。
791.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
791.flavorEn: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

792.flavor: 夺走四周所有的光，自己则变身为满月的模样，在黑夜中散发出光芒。
792.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
792.flavorEn: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

793.flavor: 从究极之洞出现，来到这个世界。好像会寄生在宝可梦或人类的身上生存下去。
793.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
793.flavorEn: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
793.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

794.flavor: 会炫耀膨胀到异常程度的肌肉。是究极异兽中的一种。
794.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
794.flavorEn: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
794.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

795.flavor: 在这个世界是异类，很危险，但在它原本栖息的世界，好像只是寻常能见的生物。
795.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
795.flavorEn: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
795.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

796.flavor: 被称为究极异兽。也有像树木一样将手脚插入地面后一动不动的。
796.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
796.flavorEn: They've been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.
796.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

797.flavor: 在这个世界是异类，很危险，但在它原本栖息的世界，好像只是寻常能见的生物。
797.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
797.flavorEn: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

798.flavor: 在这个世界是异类，很危险，但在它原本栖息的世界，好像只是寻常能见的生物。
798.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
798.flavorEn: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
798.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

799.flavor: 被称为究极异兽的未知生命。不知是不是经常觉得肚子饿，一直都在吃着什么东西。
799.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
799.flavorEn: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
799.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

800.flavor: 为生存而发狂般地寻找着光。会发射出激光，将所有东西切成碎片。
800.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
800.flavorEn: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

801.flavor: 大约500年前由科学家制作而成。被称为魂心的部分是它的本体。
801.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
801.flavorEn: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

802.flavor: 拥有潜入一切影子里的能力，所以在很长一段时间里都没有任何人发现它。
802.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
802.flavorEn: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

803.flavor: 栖息在异世界的究极异兽。会从头部的毒针朝对手喷出毒液，咯咯咯大笑。
803.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
803.flavorEn: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

804.flavor: 究极异兽中的一种。会从毒针发射出黏性很大又发光的毒液。
804.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
804.flavorEn: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

805.flavor: 像是究极异兽的谜一般的生命体。突然动起来并展开袭击的石墙，正身就是这家伙。
805.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
805.flavorEn: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
805.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

806.flavor: 从究极之洞里出现的究极异兽。用爆炸吓唬对手，趁那空当夺走对方的生命气息。
806.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
806.flavorEn: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents' surprise to rob them of their vitality.

807.flavor: 从手脚的肉球放电。当捷拉奥拉奔驰而过时，周围将充斥着电闪雷鸣，
807.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
807.flavorEn: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.
807.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

808.flavor: 美录坦们虽然聚在一起生活，但当时机到来，会由最强的那1只吸收其他的伙伴来进化。
808.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
808.flavorEn: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

809.flavor: 美录梅塔利用离心力带动沉重的螺帽挥出的拳击被认为是宝可梦界之最。
809.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
809.flavorEn: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal's heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

810.flavor: 会用木棒连续击打来攻击。在以飞快的速度击打的同时，情绪也会变得越来越高涨。
810.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
810.flavorEn: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.
810.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

811.flavor: 打着激烈的节拍战斗时，由于过于忘我，甚至不会意识到自己已经把对手打昏了。
811.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
811.flavorEn: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.
811.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

812.flavor: 打鼓技巧最高超的那一只会成为首领。性情温和，重视族群的和谐相处。
812.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
812.flavorEn: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.
812.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

813.flavor: 一旦做好了战斗的准备，它鼻头上和脚底的肉球就会发出极度的高温。
813.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
813.flavorEn: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

814.flavor: 会用脚把树果从树木上踢落，用来练习颠球，借此锻炼自己的脚法。
814.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
814.flavorEn: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

815.flavor: 拥有熟练的进攻和防守技巧。只要得到声援就会更有冲劲，但有时会为了出风头而弄巧成拙。
815.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
815.flavorEn: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

816.flavor: 皮肤在湿掉时会变色，仿佛像是隐身了一样，谁都看不见它的身影。
816.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
816.flavorEn: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
816.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

817.flavor: 头脑聪明但是怕麻烦。为了不让敌人接近自己的地盘，在各个地方都设下了陷阱。
817.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
817.flavorEn: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
817.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

818.flavor: 能从指尖射出速度高达3马赫的水枪。它的瞬膜能帮助它看穿敌人的弱点，准确地击中要害。
818.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
818.flavorEn: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
818.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

819.flavor: 由于它无论何时都在吃树果，使得它比外表看起来还要顽强。会出现在田地里寻找树果。
819.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
819.flavorEn: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

820.flavor: 无论多么坚硬的树果壳都能用引以为傲的大牙咬碎。在伽勒尔是很常见的宝可梦。
820.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
820.flavorEn: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

821.flavor: 娇小的体型让它能敏捷地飞翔。利用攻其不备的战法将体型巨大的对手玩弄于股掌之间。
821.likes: 喜欢站在高处吹风，看到天空就想飞
821.flavorEn: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

822.flavor: 经历无数次艰难的战斗后，它学会了该如何正确地判断敌人的力量。
822.likes: 喜欢站在高处吹风，看到天空就想飞
822.flavorEn: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.

823.flavor: 拥有优秀飞行能力和极度聪明头脑的它在伽勒尔地区从事飞翔出租车的工作。
823.likes: 喜欢站在高处吹风，看到天空就想飞
823.flavorEn: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.

824.flavor: 经常出现在田地里的宝可梦。会通过长在身体上的毛来感应周围发生的事。
824.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
824.flavorEn: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
824.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

825.flavor: 正在壳里成长着。用精神力量掌握外界的状况，做好进化的准备。
825.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
825.flavorEn: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
825.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

826.flavor: 释放出精神力量来调查周围的情况。它的侦测范围甚至可以达到方圆10公里。
826.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
826.flavorEn: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.
826.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

827.flavor: 性格谨慎且狡猾。在偷盗食物逃走的时候会用尾巴擦掉自己的足迹。
827.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
827.flavorEn: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
827.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

828.flavor: 靠着轻盈的身体和锐利的爪子到处去偷食物和蛋。逐电犬是它的天敌。
828.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
828.flavorEn: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.
828.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

829.flavor: 会随着微风一边转圈圈一边愉快地唱歌。许多人因为喜欢这可爱的模样而培育它。
829.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
829.flavorEn: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.
829.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

830.flavor: 用它头上的棉絮制成的线有着十分美丽动人的光泽，是伽勒尔地区的名产。
830.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
830.flavorEn: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
830.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

831.flavor: 要是身上的毛长得太长就会不能动弹。用毛辫羊的体毛织成的布结实得让人吃惊。
831.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
831.flavorEn: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

832.flavor: 长得长长的角是为了向异性求爱而存在的。它从不会把角当做武器。
832.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
832.flavorEn: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

833.flavor: 会用头上硬如岩石的角攻击敌人。趁其不备之时大口咬住对方，一旦咬住便再也不会松口。
833.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
833.flavorEn: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
833.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

834.flavor: 颈部可以伸缩。能从远处迅速伸长颈部，用锐利的牙齿解决对手。
834.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
834.flavorEn: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
834.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

835.flavor: 因为想要得到零食而帮助人类工作的贪吃鬼。总是带着电火花跑来跑去。
835.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
835.flavorEn: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.
835.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

836.flavor: 电力增强了它的脚力。当以最高速度奔跑时，时速可以轻易超过90公里。
836.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
836.flavorEn: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.
836.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

837.flavor: 在满是岩石的崎岖之路上也能像独轮车那样自在移动。靠燃烧煤炭维持生命。
837.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
837.flavorEn: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
837.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

838.flavor: 能通过高速旋转自己的脚，以30公里的时速奔跑。能喷出1000度的火焰。
838.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
838.flavorEn: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
838.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

839.flavor: 进入战斗状态后，它会把煤炭山燃烧得通红，飞撒火花来烧焦四周。
839.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
839.flavorEn: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
839.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

840.flavor: 一出生就躲进了苹果中。一边吃果肉一边成长。进化方向因苹果的味道而定。
840.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
840.flavorEn: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
840.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

841.flavor: 会用苹果皮的翅膀飞翔，并吐出强酸性的唾液。可以变成苹果的形状。
841.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
841.flavorEn: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
841.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

842.flavor: 身体被甜甜的蜜汁包裹，背部的皮尤其甘甜，过去曾经是小孩的零食。
842.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
842.flavorEn: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
842.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

843.flavor: 会从鼻孔喷射出沙子，趁敌人看不清的时候躲进地底下藏身。
843.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
843.flavorEn: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
843.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

844.flavor: 它之所以会以独特的方式盘绕自己的身体，是为了能更高效地喷射砂囊中的沙子。
844.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
844.flavorEn: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
844.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

845.flavor: 非常贪吃，会把刺梭鱼整只吞进嘴里。偶尔也会搞错对象去咬其他的宝可梦。
845.likes: 喜欢站在高处吹风，看到天空就想飞
845.flavorEn: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

846.flavor: 吃饱了之后动作会变得极度迟缓，于是就被古月鸟整只吞了下去。
846.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
846.flavorEn: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.
846.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

847.flavor: 会旋转着自己的尾鳍一口气突击。能够以超过 100节的速度贯穿猎物。
847.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
847.flavorEn: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
847.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

848.flavor: 通过让自身的毒素产生化学反应来发电。电力虽然弱，却能造成麻痹。
848.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
848.flavorEn: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
848.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

849.flavor: 气势汹汹的急性子。会大口喝下浑浊的水，吸收其中所含的毒素。
849.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
849.flavorEn: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
849.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

850.flavor: 会用滚烫的身体勒紧猎物，等到烤得恰到好处之时，就把它们大口大口地吃掉。
850.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
850.flavorEn: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

851.flavor: 性格极具攻击性。危险的不只是它烧烫的身体，大大的獠牙也锐利无比。
851.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
851.flavorEn: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

852.flavor: 智商大致相当于3岁的儿童。虽然触手经常断掉，但因为能再生，所以它并不在意。
852.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
852.flavorEn: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

853.flavor: 会为了试自己的身手而登上陆地寻找对手。战斗结束后就会回到海里。
853.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
853.flavorEn: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

854.flavor: 被它当成住处的茶杯是有名的古董餐具。市面上有很多赝品。
854.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
854.flavorEn: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

855.flavor: 每当发现喝剩的红茶，它就会把自己的身体倒进去，让那壶红茶变成怖思壶。
855.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
855.flavorEn: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

856.flavor: 喜欢没有人烟的地方。一旦感觉到强烈的感情，就会一溜烟地逃走。
856.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
856.flavorEn: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

857.flavor: 会用头上的辫子攻击对手，让对方安静下来。破坏力强到能一击KO职业拳击手。
857.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
857.flavorEn: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

858.flavor: 又被称为森林魔女。如果有人大吵大闹，可能会被它用触手上的爪子撕碎。
858.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
858.flavorEn: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

859.flavor: 不但会溜进民宅偷盗，还会吸收人们悔恨时的负面能量。
859.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
859.flavorEn: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
859.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

860.flavor: 喜欢动歪脑筋，把人们引诱到深夜的森林中。似乎拥有培育农作物的能力。
860.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
860.flavorEn: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.
860.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

861.flavor: 毛发能发挥肌肉纤维般的作用。伸展开来时会像触手那样把对手缠绕起来。
861.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
861.flavorEn: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.
861.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

862.flavor: 在不断的斗争中得到了进化。它交叉着双臂发出的怒吼能让一切对手都为之胆怯。
862.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
862.flavorEn: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
862.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

863.flavor: 在日复一日的战斗中得以进化。进化的结果是那危险的指甲，留长后能当作短剑来用。
863.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
863.flavorEn: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

864.flavor: 一定要小心它那包覆着灵魂的灵体。如果触摸到，就会像石头一样动弹不得。
864.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
864.flavorEn: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

865.flavor: 会用坚硬的葱叶抵挡攻击，接着用锋利的茎反击。它的葱既是武器也是食材。
865.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
865.flavorEn: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

866.flavor: 幽默的动作使它获得了众人的喜爱。能从腹部的图案释放出精神力量。
866.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
866.flavorEn: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
866.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

867.flavor: 绝对不能触摸它影子般的身体，否则它会让你看到印刻在它画中的恐怖记忆。
867.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
867.flavorEn: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
867.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

868.flavor: 据说有小仙奶现身过的蛋糕店保证能生意兴隆。
868.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
868.flavorEn: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

869.flavor: 当它感到幸福的时候，手中产生出的鲜奶油会变得更加香浓甜美。
869.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
869.flavorEn: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

870.flavor: 6只为一体的宝可梦。惯于团队行动，会一边变换阵形一边战斗。
870.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
870.flavorEn: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

871.flavor: 每根刺里都储存着电力。即使是折断的刺也至少能连续放电3小时。
871.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
871.flavorEn: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.
871.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

872.flavor: 会吃地面上的积雪。吃得越多，背上的刺就会长得越挺拔。
872.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
872.flavorEn: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.
872.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

873.flavor: 绝不放过破坏山野环境的人。会用冰冷的翅膀四处飞翔，制造出暴风雪来惩罚他们。
873.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
873.flavorEn: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
873.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

874.flavor: 每年会有一天，它们会在特定的时间突然出现，聚集在一起排成一个圈。
874.likes: 喜欢硬邦邦的地方，趴着一动不动
874.flavorEn: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
874.likesEn: hard ground and staying perfectly still

875.flavor: 无论何时都用冰块冰镇着自己怕热的脸。会把头顶上的毛垂到海里钓食物吃。
875.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
875.flavorEn: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
875.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

876.flavor: 能通过自己的角去感受附近生物的情感。正面情绪是它的能量之源。
876.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
876.flavorEn: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

877.flavor: 无论怎么吃都会马上肚子饿。十分珍爱自己用电烘烤过的种子，随时都带在身上。
877.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
