877.flavorEn: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
877.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

878.flavor: 擅长需要力气的工作。铜质的身体会因雨水而生锈，转变成鲜艳的绿色。
878.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
878.flavorEn: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

879.flavor: 群居的宝可梦。鼻子的握力十分强劲，甚至能把大石头弄得粉碎。
879.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
879.flavorEn: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

880.flavor: 会用尾部结实的肌肉发电。与下半身相比，上半身真的太小了。
880.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
880.flavorEn: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.
880.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

881.flavor: 曾经生活在古代的海边，能用身体的冰来保存食物，但由于动作太迟缓而灭绝了。
881.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
881.flavorEn: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
881.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

882.flavor: 虽然能用自豪的脚力以60公里的时速奔跑，但是只能在水中呼吸。
882.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
882.flavorEn: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can't breathe unless it's underwater.
882.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

883.flavor: 面部的皮肤无论受到什么攻击都不会受伤，但由于呼吸起来不方便而灭绝了。
883.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
883.flavorEn: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
883.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

884.flavor: 由特殊金属构成的身体十分轻盈，能够灵活地活动。不喜欢下雨，所以住在洞窟里。
884.likes: 喜欢闪亮亮的金属，身体硬得很
884.flavorEn: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

885.flavor: 虽然单独1只弱得甚至敌不过小孩，但会和伙伴合作一起锻炼，通过进化而变得更强。
885.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
885.flavorEn: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
885.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

886.flavor: 要是没让自己在照顾的多龙梅西亚乘在头上就静不下心来，甚至会因此试图把别的宝可梦放到头上。
886.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
886.flavorEn: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
886.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

887.flavor: 它角里的多龙梅西亚似乎满心期待着能被以音速发射出去。
887.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
887.flavorEn: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
887.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

888.flavor: 这只宝可梦被认为是沉睡已久的藏玛然特的姐姐，也有人认为它们之间是劲敌关系。
888.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
888.flavorEn: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it's Zamazenta's elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

889.flavor: 以石像般的姿态陷入长久沉眠的宝可梦。几乎就要被人们所遗忘。
889.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
889.flavorEn: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

890.flavor: 来自于2万年前坠落到地上的陨石之中。似乎与极巨化之谜有所关联。
890.likes: 喜欢角落和奇怪的味道，不太受欢迎
890.flavorEn: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

891.flavor: 拉紧头上又白又长的体毛，就会变得斗气势高昂，并从丹田涌出力量。
891.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
891.flavorEn: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

892.flavor: 生活在遥远地区的山岳地带。通过在断崖绝壁上奔跑来锻炼腰腿，磨炼招式。
892.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
892.flavorEn: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

893.flavor: 长在身上的藤蔓断掉之后会变成土壤的养分，帮助森林中的植物成长。
893.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
893.flavorEn: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
893.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

894.flavor: 整个身体是制造电能的器官。可以制造出伽勒尔全域所需的电力。
894.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
894.flavorEn: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.
894.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

895.flavor: 整个身体是龙之能量的结晶。据说它拥有所有龙宝可梦的能力。
895.likes: 喜欢耀武扬威地占住最高的地方
895.flavorEn: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
895.likesEn: the highest perch it can find

896.flavor: 拥有十分惊人的怪力。戴在脸上的冰之面罩硬度是钻石的100倍
896.likes: 喜欢凉凉的环境，大热天会没精神
896.flavorEn: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
896.likesEn: cool places, and wilts in the heat

897.flavor: 在黑暗的夜晚中奔跑，吸取正在睡觉的生物的生命能量。喜欢孤独和静寂。
897.likes: 喜欢黑暗，也喜欢悄悄捉弄人
897.flavorEn: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

898.flavor: 曾经在很久以前统治着伽勒尔的传说之王。拥有治愈心灵和让草木发芽的能力。
898.likes: 喜欢安静，被盯着看会让人心里发毛
898.flavorEn: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

899.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
899.flavorEn: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

900.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
900.flavorEn: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
900.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

901.likes: 喜欢干燥的沙土，最讨厌洗澡
901.flavorEn: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
901.likesEn: dry sand and dust, and hates baths

902.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
902.flavorEn: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
902.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

903.likes: 精力旺盛，喜欢找人比划两下
903.flavorEn: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

904.likes: 喜欢半夜活动，白天基本在打瞌睡
904.flavorEn: " It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
904.likesEn: late nights, and naps during the day

905.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
905.flavorEn: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

906.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
906.flavorEn: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
906.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

907.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
907.flavorEn: The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokémon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
907.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

908.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
908.flavorEn: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what's going on.
908.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

909.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
909.flavorEn: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

910.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
910.flavorEn: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

911.likes: 喜欢温暖的地方，晒太阳时会舒服得眯起眼睛
911.flavorEn: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

912.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
912.flavorEn: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.
912.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

913.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
913.flavorEn: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.
913.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

914.likes: 喜欢泡在水里，被水花溅到会很开心
914.flavorEn: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.
914.likesEn: soaking in water and splashing about

915.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
915.flavorEn: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

916.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
916.flavorEn: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

917.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
917.flavorEn: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.
917.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

918.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
918.flavorEn: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.
918.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

919.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
919.flavorEn: It's highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.
919.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

920.likes: 喜欢躲在叶子和草丛里，一惊动就窜走
920.flavorEn: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can't stay in this mode for long.
920.likesEn: leaves and tall grass to hide in

921.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
921.flavorEn: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
921.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

922.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
922.flavorEn: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.
922.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

923.likes: 喜欢噼里啪啦放电，但很怕潮湿
923.flavorEn: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.
923.likesEn: crackling with static, though it hates damp

924.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
924.flavorEn: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

925.likes: 喜欢待在熟悉的地方，安安静静地待着
925.flavorEn: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

926.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
926.flavorEn: The yeast in Fidough's breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

927.likes: 喜欢甜食和漂亮的东西，脾气有点任性
927.flavorEn: The surface of this Pokémon's skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

928.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
928.flavorEn: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.
928.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

929.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
929.flavorEn: It basks in the sun to its heart's content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.
929.likesEn: sunshine and the smell of fresh soil

930.likes: 喜欢晒太阳，也喜欢新鲜的泥土味
